sections.description:
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS ORDINANCE, 2000 (EXTENSION OF
PROVINCIALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS OF BALOCHISTAN) RE
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL GOVERNMENT ELECTIONS ORDINANCE, 2000
(EXTENSION OF PROVINCIALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS OF BALOCHISTAN)
REGULATION, 2002
REGULATION I OF 2002
A Regulation to
apply the Balochsitan Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000 (VI of 2000),
to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of the Balochistan
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 9th July, 2002]
No. 1egis.4-17/Law/70-II,
dated 9-7-2002.--The following Regulation made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 1st July, 2002, is hereby published for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient to apply
the Balochistan Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000 to the Provincially
Administered Tribal Areas of the Balochistan.
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of Emergency of the Fourteenth day of October, 1999 and in
exercise of powers conferred by Article 5 of the Provisional Constitution
Order, 1999 (Order No. 1 of 1999) and with clause (4) of article 247 of the
Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, and in exercise of all
powers enabling him in that behalf, the Governor of Balochistan with the prior
approval of the President is pleased to make the following Regulation:--
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.--(1) This Regulation may be called the Balochistan Local
Government Elections Ordinance, 2000 (Extension to Provincially Administered
Tribal Areas of Balochistan) Regulation, 2002.
(2) It shall apply to whole of
the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas of Balochistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 5th day of October, 2000.
2. Application of Laws.--The
provisions of the Balochistan Local Government Elections Ordinance, 2000 (VI of
2000), and all rules order, notifications made or issued thereunder on or after
the 5th October, 2000 shall apply to the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas
of Balochistan.
3. Certain laws to cease to
operate.--(1) If, immediately before the commencement of this Regulation
there was in force in the Provincially Administered Tribal Areas or any part
thereof any law, instruments, custom or usage having the force of law
corresponding to the Ordinance mentioned in section 2, then such law,
instrument, custom or usage shall, upon such commencement, cease to have effect
in the said areas.
(2) Nothing in subsection, (1)
shall affect,--
(a)
the previous operation of such law, instrument custom or usage; or
(b)
any obligation or liability acquired or accrued or any penalty, forfeiture or punishment incurred in respect of any
offence punishable under, such law, instrument.,
custom of usage; or
(c)
any investigation legal proceeding or remedy in respect of any such obligation,
liability, penalty, forfeiture
or punishment may be imposed, as of subsection (1) had not come into force.
4. Validation.--Anything
done, proceeding initiated, order passed, power exercised and power conferred
on, or by any authority under the law specified in section 2 and rules, orders
and notifications made or issued thereunder on or after the 5th October, 2000,
shall be deemed to have been validly done, initiated, passed, issued, exercised
and conferred.
